description.value: Kwan Luck is a Cantonese seafood restaurant on Kingsway in East Vancouver, serving a broad menu of classic Chinese dishes including clay pot rice, seafood, and a range of pork and beef preparations. The restaurant offers online ordering and a substantial dine-in menu that spans dozens of items. It sits along a busy arterial corridor that connects several Vancouver neighbourhoods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at kwanluckrestaurant.com is live and confirms both the address (2516 Kingsway, Vancouver, BC Canada V5R5H2) and phone (604-431-3890), matching the OSM record. The presence of an online ordering system with menu categories confirms active takeout service. No cyclist-specific amenities—bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging—are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all such fields are null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Kwan Luck Seafood Restaurant' but the website consistently uses 'Kwan Luck Restaurant' — minor name discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, operating Chinese restaurant on a major cycling corridor, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags.
